p: Give me thy vineyard: Though Ahab's tyranny is condemned by the Holy Spirit, yet he was not so rigorous that he would take from another man his right without full recompense.
upon his bed: Thus the wicked do not consider what is just and lawful, but fret inwardly when they cannot have their inordinate lusts satisfied.
Dost thou now govern the kingdom: As though she said, "You do not know what it means to reign. Command and do not beg".
fast: For then they used to enquire of men's faults: for no one could truly fast if he was a notorious sinner.
men of his city: Thus the worldlings contrary to God's commandment, who does not consent to the shedding of innocent blood, would rather obey the wicked commandments of princes than the just laws.

Arise: This example of monstrous cruelty the Holy Spirit leaves to us, to the intent that we should abhor all tyranny, and especially in those whom nature and kind should move to be pitiful and inclined to mercy.
Hast thou killed: Do you think to have an advantage by murdering an innocent?
In the place where dogs licked: This was fulfilled in Joram his son 2Ki 9:25,26.
sell himself to work wickedness in: By the wicked counsel of his wife he became a vile idolater, and cruel murderer, as one that gave himself wholly to serve sin.
softly: In token of mourning, or as some read, barefooted.
son's days will I bring the: Meaning, in Joram's time, 2Ki 9:26.
